contexts.text: Preface. [3]. James = charity. AC 10087:2. AR 356. SE 1217. SE 2136. AE 8:2. AE 206:3. AE 600:9. AE 821:2.
By the apostle James is meant the charity of the Church.
James represented the good of charity of the Church.
Thus (Luther) cursed the Epistle of James. LJPost 34.

When they are thinking from the doctrine of faith alone, and it is contradicted from the Epistle of James... there appears as it were a knife lying out to kill those who are of that opinion; and there comes up on the one side the idea of Luther, and on the other the idea of James... the reason being that Luther excluded the Epistle of James.
